misc.title: This makes me wildly mad My mother abandoned me as a baby, tried to kill me due to a bipolar disorder and drug use and my father fought with every ounce of his soul to have custody of me In every scho
misc.text: This makes me wildly mad My mother abandoned me as a baby, tried to kill me due to a bipolar disorder and drug use and my father fought with every ounce of his soul to have custody of me In every school I ever attended the teachers always treated me a bit different because I only had my father and he couldn't be in another relationship after all that. Growing up in a full on man cave bachelor style was kind of a result of this. I had to do things for myself and be independent probably more than some others. There was no mom to always coddle me. But he always did the best he could and to disrespect the heroism of that makes me irate. Fuck this person 𝓑ᥫ᭡ (@quesadaaa_) Remembering how when my Mum left, my Dad still didn't learn to cook or do anything else she'd been doing solo all those years. I quickly taught myself to cook at age 10, using books from the library, as soon as I realised that every meal with my father was going to be a bag of frozen sausage rolls, plain toast, or nothing at all. By 13, I was cooking meals for him too. And that's how male incompetence trains women. Video — https://nitter.net/quesadaaa_/status/2083501998393929828#m
